title: Lao Zi once said, "Care about what other people think and yo…

sents.en: Lao Zi once said, "Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner." People-pleasing, or seeking self-worth through others' approval, is unproductive and an exhausting way to go through life.
sents.cn: 老子曾说：“在意别人的看法，你就永远成为他人的囚徒。”讨好他人，即通过别人的认可来寻求自我价值，是一种低效且令人筋疲尽的生活方式。

sents.en: Why do we allow what others think of us to have so much power over how we feel about ourselves?
sents.cn: 为何我们允许别人的看法对我们自身的感受拥有如此大的支配力？

sents.en: If it's true that you can't please all people all of the time, wouldn't it make sense to stop trying?
sents.cn: 如果你不可能时时取悦所有人，那停止尝试难道不是更明智吗？

sents.en: Unfortunately, sense often isn't driving our behavior.
sents.cn: 遗憾的是，理智往往并未驱动我们的行为。

sents.en: For social beings who desire love and belonging, wanting to be liked, and caring about the effect we have on others, is healthy and allows us to make connections.
sents.cn: 对于渴望爱与归属的社会性的人而言，想要被喜欢、在意我们对他人的影响，是健康的，也让我们建立联系。

sents.en: However, where we get into trouble is when our self-worth is dependent upon whether we win someone's approval or not.
sents.cn: 然而，问题出在当我们的自我价值取决于是否赢得他人认可之时。

sents.en: This need to be liked can be traced back to when we were children and were completely dependent on others to take care of us.
sents.cn: 这种被喜欢的渴望，可追溯至我们儿时完全依赖他人照顾的时期。

sents.en: Small children are not just learning how to walk and communicate, they are also trying to learn how the world works.
sents.cn: 幼童不仅在学走路和沟通，也在努力弄懂世界运作的方式。

sents.en: We learn about who we are and what is expected of us based on interactions with others so, to a four-year-old, if Mommy or Daddy doesn't like him or her, there is the danger that they will abandon them.
sents.cn: 我们通过对他人的互动来认识自己以及他人对我们的期望，所以对一个四岁孩子来说，如果爸爸妈妈不喜欢他/她，就有被抛弃的危险。

sents.en: We need to understand that when we desperately want someone to approve of us, it's being driven by that little kid part of us that is still terrified of abandonment.
sents.cn: 我们要明白，当我们拼命渴望某人认可我们时，驱动它的是我们内心那个仍恐惧被抛弃的小孩部分。

sents.en: As you become more capable of providing yourself with the approval you seek, your need for external validation will start to vanish, leaving you stronger, more confident, and yes, happier in your life.
sents.cn: 当你越来越能为自己提供所寻求的认可时，你对外部肯定的需求便会开始消失，让你更坚强、更自信，也更幸福。

sents.en: Imagine how much time we lose each moment we restrain our authentic selves in an effort to be liked.
sents.cn: 试想我们每时刻克制真实自我以讨好他人，浪费了多少时间。

sents.en: If we base our worth on the opinions of others, we cheat ourselves of the power to shape our experiences and embrace life not only for others but also for ourselves, because ultimately, there is no difference.
sents.cn: 如果我们把自我价值建立在他人看法之上，便是剥夺了自己塑造经历、拥抱生活的能力——不仅为他人，也为自己，因为说到底并无分别。

sents.en: So embrace the cliché and love yourself as it's highly doubtful that you'll regret it.
sents.cn: 所以请接纳这句老话，爱自己吧，因为你极不可能为此后悔。
